objective: Fit one policy of elementary logical gates to discover a mixing braid and inverse, then freeze its actions and message code. On held-out public rewiring, measure when it transmits one distinction and when it preserves the entire joint relation.
status: Atomic programs learned a mixing braid and separately learned undo. The frozen reader answered 2,792,448/2,792,448 queries across 606 wirings, used minimum width in 605, and recovered all 512 joint tables. A guided sequence also learned both moves.
title: Learn reversible crossings and downstream memory from atomic logical actions
